title.zh: Lightning Labs提出比特币扩容方案LayerTree：最多约100万用户共享单个UTXO
title.en: Lightning Labs提出比特币扩容方案LayerTree：最多约100万用户共享单个UTXO

current_state.zh: Lightning Labs unveiled LayerTree, a non-custodial Bitcoin scaling design in which roughly one million users could share a single UTXO via off-chain Merkle-sum trees with unilateral exits and Lightning connectivity, contingent on still-unactivated covenant opcodes.
current_state.en: Lightning Labs unveiled LayerTree, a non-custodial Bitcoin scaling design in which roughly one million users could share a single UTXO via off-chain Merkle-sum trees with unilateral exits and Lightning connectivity, contingent on still-unactivated covenant opcodes.
